justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Specialized MSK knowledge for AT population; comparative outcome studies vs general BOC not available.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Significant experience requirements plus exam; comparable investment to ABPTS board certification.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to orthopedic PT and AT caseloads; somewhat narrower than OCS but still broadly applicable.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No specific billing premium; credential demonstrates orthopedic competency for facility credentialing and referral networks.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Less employer recognition than ABPTS OCS; moderate demand in orthopedic athletic training settings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Athletes may prefer specialist-trained AT for complex injuries.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: AT-based ortho services (sports, performance) have cash-pay appeal, particularly in athletic populations.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Less consumer recognition than PT-side credentials, modest premium potential.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Relatively rare within ATs, providing some differentiation in sports-med spaces.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Can build sports/ortho cash practices around AT staff with this credential.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Low direct consumer recognition of BOC specialties.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Recognized in AT education programs but limited weight in PT/OT faculty hiring.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Modest publication footprint in AT and sports-med literature.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Useful for sports/ortho instruction, especially in AT programs.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Solid sports-med and ortho evidence base underlying the specialty.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rare in PT/OT faculty postings; more relevant in AT-specific academia.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Fair time/cost relative to scope of recognition.
